data.name: Doruk
data.gender_notes: Doruk is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived Doruk bedeutet 'Donner' in der türkischen Sprache und leitet sich von dem türkischen Wort 'Doruk' ab, das eine Art der Trommel bezeichnet. Der Name symbolisiert die Kraft und die Energie des Donners. The name Doruk carries the meaning “Thunder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Turkish. Parents who choose Doruk usually hope their child will grow to embody thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Der Name Doruk ist spirituell ein Zeichen der Macht und der Energie des Donners und symbolisiert die Schutz und die Stabilität, die durch diese Kraft gegeben wird.
data.etymology: Doruk belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Thunder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Doruk total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Doruk holds a significant cultural impact as it is derived from the Turkish language and translates to 'thunder'. This name is of great historical importance in Turkish culture, as it is associated with the earlier Seljuk Empire where this name was given to the bands of soldiers called 'Doruklu' who traveled throughout Anatolia, spreading their might and strength, similar to the powerful and destructive effects of thunder.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Doruk represents the immeasurable power and energy of the divine realm, harnessing the destructive yet transformative force of the thunderstorm. In Turkish folklore and mythology, the thunderstorm was believed to be the work of a mighty bridge-builder, while some believed it to be God himself delivering a message to his people.
